items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Dud' appears only in a note/parenthetical context, not in the interviewee's spoken narrative.

ctx.x: Well, let's see, what did I do after that? Well that job actually broke my heart, it really did. I was a little lost there for a little while. And then I did four or five weeks with John Kirby at the Apollo Bar and Grill. Then I did the same job with Doug Bascomb.
